Methodology notes

Dates shown here are extracted from pin titles, descriptions, and layer names. The KML export does not include Google’s internal per-pin creation timestamp.

Images remain associated with their original pins. Map data and locally archived images are stored separately; the original source links are preserved.

Italian is the original map text. English, Ukrainian, and Russian have been retranslated from Italian with AI and await editorial review.
